create.name: Lauren Rainbow
create.bio:
Lauren Rainbow is an evidential medium, spiritual teacher and sacred travel guide based in New Hampshire. Her mediumship began in 2001, when a series of synchronistic events opened her to sensing and hearing loved ones in spirit, and she went on to train with a number of established mediums. Raised in community theatre, she is most at home demonstrating on stage, and she has worked alongside mediums such as Tony Stockwell and John Holland, with whom she co-wrote The Mediumship Training Deck for Hay House. She has taught at Omega Institute, Kripalu and Lily Dale.

Her work combines evidential mediumship and Akashic Soul Sessions with teaching on intuition, spirit guides and heart-centred meditation. She gives private sessions, live spirit-message evenings and meditation and sound bath events in New England, runs an online community with monthly practice circles, and sells guided meditations and Akashic Records courses. Since 2017 she has led small-group sacred journeys to Egypt, India, Peru, Nepal and Mexico. Her guided meditations are also available on Hay House Unlimited and on her YouTube channel.

books.title: The Mediumship Training Deck: 50 Practical Tools for Developing Your Connection to the Other-Side
books.author: John Holland, Lauren Rainbow
books.description: A deck of 50 cards with a guidebook, published by Hay House, offering exercises for developing intuition and mediumship. Each card gives a practical tool for strengthening the connection with spirit.

courses.title: Mystical India: A Soulful Soul Journey with Lauren Rainbow & Tony Stockwell
courses.description: An eleven-day pilgrimage to Haridwar, Rishikesh, Agra and New Delhi, with ceremony on the Ganges, meditation and mediumship teaching. Tony Stockwell joins for the Haridwar and Rishikesh retreat portion.

courses.title: Total Solar Eclipse of Egypt
courses.description: A small-group journey of no more than 16 people timed for the total solar eclipse over Luxor on 2 August 2027. It includes private visits to the Sphinx, Philae and the statue of Sekhmet, a Nile dahabiya cruise and daily ceremony.

courses.title: Mystical Egypt 2.0: A Journey Through the Ancient Mysteries
courses.description: A sacred journey through Egypt with Lauren Rainbow and medium Cindy Kaza, including a private visit to the Sphinx, meditation in the King's Chamber and a Nile dahabiya cruise. Each day includes teachings, meditations and channelled messages.

courses.title: Lauren Rainbow Community
courses.description: An online membership with live monthly practice circles, mediumship messages and guided meditations. A space to develop intuitive, psychic and mediumship abilities alongside others.

courses.title: Akashic Records 101: Opening the Book of Your Soul
courses.description: An introductory course on what the Akashic Records are and how to access them. It lays a grounded foundation for further practice and for understanding your soul's path.

courses.title: Akashic Relationships: The Soul Contract Masterclass
courses.description: A three-hour recorded masterclass in which Lauren works with the Akashic Records to explore the soul contracts behind close relationships. Suited to those who already have some familiarity with the Records.

courses.title: Heart of Hathor
courses.description: A guided meditation and activation centred on Hathor, the Egyptian goddess of love, joy and music. Drawn from Lauren's work at Egyptian temple sites.

courses.title: Sekhmet: The Sacred Witness
courses.description: A guided meditation and energy activation with the Egyptian goddess Sekhmet. It invites a fierce, compassionate presence into personal practice.

courses.title: Medium Lauren Rainbow (Epping Community Theater)
courses.description: An evening demonstration of evidential mediumship at Epping Community Theater in Epping, New Hampshire. Lauren passes on messages from spirit to members of the audience.

courses.title: Messages from Spirit with Lauren Rainbow & Tony Stockwell
courses.description: An evening of evidential mediumship with Lauren Rainbow and British medium Tony Stockwell, connecting audience members with loved ones in spirit. A ticket does not guarantee a reading.

free_resources.title: Sitting in the Power Meditation
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation, sent by email, for connecting with the heart and trusting your intuition. Lauren suggests it as a daily practice.

free_resources.title: Connect with Your Spirit Guides
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide introducing how to work with your spirit guides. It includes practical techniques for building the connection and setting up a sacred space at home.
